summary: Short corner kerb with homes 6-10 m away and a junction.
reasons: Houses 6 m and 10 m from kerb

best_section.where: south kerb of Stanley Terrace just east of the side-street corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 6 m and 10 m away on the same side; Drysdale house 15 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road with a few cars parked at the kerb; a van would sit near the corner.
drivers.traffic: Through road at a junction, moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Trees to the north shade it in the morning and midday.
